excerpt.zh: 派遣一艘舰船去外星人的母星，我们将在它们身上收集那些我们认为它们从我们身上搜集了的数据。
excerpt.en: Sending a ship to the alien homeworld, we will be able to gather the same data on them that we suspect them to have on us.

title.zh: 绘制基因图谱收获成效

texts.zh: 虽然我们没有在基因组检测中获得想要的细节信息，但研究进一步阐明了我们自身的遗传学特性。我们以往在[Root.GetHomeWorldName]的地面战争中所使用的一部分武器对外星生物可能完全无效。这个新的发现帮助我们开发了现代化的作战学说。
texts.en: Although we have not found the specific details on the examined genome we hoped, our research has clarified much about the peculiarities of our own genetics. Some of the weapons what proved useful in the wars on [Root.GetHomeWorldName] in the past might be entirely wasted on alien lifeforms. These new insights have helped us develop updated combat doctrines.

label.zh: 要是他们真的盯上了我们，这就能派上用场。
label.en: If they really are targeting us, we may need it.

note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.
